limits: Fresh full-admission scans. ICU input and dated procedures do not guarantee hospital-wide transfusion ascertainment; medication-name search is not a complete blood-bank registry.

phase11_admissions.query: SELECT a.subject_id,a.hadm_id,try_cast(admittime AS TIMESTAMP) admittime,try_cast(dischtime AS TIMESTAMP) dischtime,try_cast(deathtime AS TIMESTAMP) deathtime,hospital_expire_flag FROM read_csv('/root/controlled_data/MIMIC_IV/3.1/raw/mimic-iv-3.1/hosp/admissions.csv.gz',header=true,all_varchar=true) a SEMI JOIN phase11_selected USING(hadm_id)

phase11_transfers.query: SELECT t.hadm_id,t.careunit,try_cast(intime AS TIMESTAMP) intime,try_cast(outtime AS TIMESTAMP) outtime FROM read_csv('/root/controlled_data/MIMIC_IV/3.1/raw/mimic-iv-3.1/hosp/transfers.csv.gz',header=true,all_varchar=true) t SEMI JOIN phase11_selected USING(hadm_id)

phase11_icustays.query: SELECT i.hadm_id,try_cast(intime AS TIMESTAMP) intime,try_cast(outtime AS TIMESTAMP) outtime FROM read_csv('/root/controlled_data/MIMIC_IV/3.1/raw/mimic-iv-3.1/icu/icustays.csv.gz',header=true,all_varchar=true) i SEMI JOIN phase11_selected USING(hadm_id)

phase11_platelet_inputs.query: SELECT t.hadm_id,t.itemid,try_cast(starttime AS TIMESTAMP) starttime,try_cast(endtime AS TIMESTAMP) endtime,try_cast(amount AS DOUBLE) amount,amountuom,statusdescription FROM read_csv('/root/controlled_data/MIMIC_IV/3.1/raw/mimic-iv-3.1/icu/inputevents.csv.gz',header=true,all_varchar=true) t SEMI JOIN phase11_selected USING(hadm_id) WHERE itemid IN ('225170','226369','227071')

phase11_platelet_procedures.query: SELECT p.hadm_id,try_cast(p.chartdate AS DATE) chartdate,p.icd_code,p.icd_version FROM read_csv('/root/controlled_data/MIMIC_IV/3.1/raw/mimic-iv-3.1/hosp/procedures_icd.csv.gz',header=true,all_varchar=true) p JOIN read_csv('/root/controlled_data/MIMIC_IV/3.1/raw/mimic-iv-3.1/hosp/d_icd_procedures.csv.gz',header=true,all_varchar=true) d USING(icd_code,icd_version) SEMI JOIN phase11_selected USING(hadm_id) WHERE lower(d.long_title) LIKE 'transfusion of%platelet%'

phase11_platelet_emar.query: SELECT m.hadm_id,m.emar_id,m.medication,m.event_txt,try_cast(charttime AS TIMESTAMP) charttime,try_cast(storetime AS TIMESTAMP) storetime FROM read_csv('/root/controlled_data/MIMIC_IV/3.1/raw/mimic-iv-3.1/hosp/emar.csv.gz',header=true,all_varchar=true) m SEMI JOIN phase11_selected USING(hadm_id) WHERE regexp_matches(lower(medication),'platelet|thrombocyte')

phase11_platelet_labs.query: SELECT l.subject_id,l.hadm_id,l.labevent_id,l.specimen_id,l.itemid,try_cast(charttime AS TIMESTAMP) charttime,try_cast(storetime AS TIMESTAMP) storetime,try_cast(valuenum AS DOUBLE) valuenum,l.valueuom FROM read_csv('/root/controlled_data/MIMIC_IV/3.1/raw/mimic-iv-3.1/hosp/labevents.csv.gz',header=true,all_varchar=true) l SEMI JOIN phase11_selected USING(hadm_id) WHERE itemid IN ('51265','53189')
